# Starfield

How To Navigate

Left drag rotates around your current Starfield anchor.

Right drag pans through space without changing orientation.

Scroll moves forward and backward through the field.

Click a gold region to isolate that local thought cluster.

Click a star to focus an excerpt and inspect its replies.

Hold hover for a moment to preview the excerpt text.

Star Meanings

If an excerpt is both liked and bookmarked, the bookmark blue takes priority.

Switch Star Color to Authors to tint excerpts by author instead; selected, hovered, searched, and region-highlighted stars still keep their emphasis colors.
